Forward P/E of 9.21 and PEG of 0.91 price in almost no growth premium despite +4.5% revenue growth and strong FCF ($2.2B). ROE 14.9%, op margin 17.5%, D/E only 14.5x — balance sheet is clean relative to peers. Analyst EPS revisions +2.3% over 60 days suggest estimates are stabilizing and potentially inflecting. Enterprise IT cost optimization trends benefit efficient outsourcers like CTSH. TECHNICAL: Basing pattern at 42% of the 52w range is Stage 1-to-2 transition territory per the strategy mandate. SMA50 slope is +10.9% (strong rising support). Current overextension vs SMA50 (+9.7%) means we need to wait for consolidation. A pullback to $56 would put price closer to SMA50 and improve risk/reward materially. Stop at $52.50 is 1.77x ATR below a $56 entry — within the 1.5-2.0x rule and well under the 15% ceiling.
